name: Custodian (Kraken)
summary: Hosted custodian: email/password → KYC → mandatory 2FA (authenticator). Account claim only — no private key. Counterparty and auth risks remain on the path.

name: Custodian (Wallet of Satoshi)
summary: Custodial Lightning with email-style login and no KYC (typical). Completes after the email auth step.

name: Federated custody (Fedi member)
summary: Join an existing Fedimint federation via Fedi: official download → invite → social backup choice → personal backup → PIN. No on-chain private key; federation intrinsic risks apply.

name: Self-custodied hot (BlueWallet)
summary: Phone hot wallet: official install → Bitcoin wallet → BIP84 → create → offline backup → verify → receive → send risks. PRIV+PUB when complete.

name: Self-custodied cold (Trezor + passphrase)
summary: Trezor Safe path: Suite → firmware → authenticity → single-share BIP39 → PIN → enable passphrase → test → store separately → verify receive. PRIV+PUB.

name: Self-custodied cold (Trezor 2-of-3 Shamir)
summary: Multi-share Backup: 3 shares / threshold 2 → write+verify each share → Home / Physical storage / Family → never digitize → recombine on Trezor to spend.

name: Multisig 2-of-3 (Seedsigner + Sparrow)
summary: Three Seedsigners (same-vendor risk): dice/RNG per key → Family/Home/Physical storage → Sparrow 2-of-3 → xpubs → descriptor at all three locations → verify receive → PSBT QR spend.
